subject.title: fix(cron): bound cron quarantine sidecar file reads

question: Should shipped cron quarantine sidecars become regular-file-only and capped at 8 MiB when rejection can block later durable cron writes until operator recovery?
rationale: The implementation correctly prevents unbounded allocation, but changing accepted persisted state and the upgrade recovery contract requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Accept Existing Recovery Contract
options.body: Adopt the strict limit and rely on doctor’s explicit read-failure warning and manual repair guidance for out-of-contract sidecars.

options.title: Extend Doctor Before Merge
options.body: Add a doctor repair that archives or removes oversized or non-regular sidecars before runtime enforcement can block writes.

recommendation.title: Accept Existing Recovery Contract
recommendation.body: Adopt the strict limit and rely on doctor’s explicit read-failure warning and manual repair guidance for out-of-contract sidecars.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged history shows the strongest ownership of the affected cron SQLite persistence and durability semantics.
